company.name: SensorSurf
company.description: SensorSurf is like Snowflake for robotics -- a platform for analyzing petabytes of sensor data collected by large robot fleets. We launched in December and our software is now running on 15 industrial robots, saving our customers the need for a full-time data engineer. SensorSurf is the product we wish we'd had while working on robotics and machine learning at Uber, Expedia, and Sea Machines Robotics. We're backed by Y Combinator (W23).
